create_LayerNorm_module: create a Haiku LayerNorm module to normalize inputs along specified axes with optional scale and offset
create_InstanceNorm_module: create a Haiku InstanceNorm module to normalize inputs along spatial dimensions with channels_last format
use_LayerNorm_call: use a LayerNorm module to normalize a JAX array by calling it with input tensor data
use_to_axes_or_slice: use to_axes_or_slice to convert an int, slice, or iterable of ints into a normalized axes tuple
use_to_abs_axes: use to_abs_axes to convert negative axis indices or slices into absolute axis tuples given ndim
